about_body: TikSave AI is a creator toolkit for TikTok: analyze public videos, download them in your chosen quality, polish your own uploads in the Clean Export studio (trim, crop, compress, GIF, mute and more), and grow with AI captions, hashtags, transcripts and translations in English, Urdu and Roman Urdu. No accounts, no watermark removal, no private content — just honest tools that respect creators.
about_built: TikSave AI is crafted by Asad Bukhari × Muse AI — a fast, clean and honest toolkit for creators, built in the open.

privacy_body: TikSave AI respects your privacy. No accounts are required and we never sell personal data. URLs you paste are used only to fetch public video metadata; uploaded files are processed in temporary server storage and deleted automatically after processing. Server logs may record anonymous technical events (errors, request counts) to keep the service reliable. If you contact us by email, your message is used only to reply. Do not upload sensitive personal media to this demo-grade hosted app.

terms_body: By using TikSave AI you agree: (1) You will only download or process content you own or have permission to use. (2) The tool works only with public videos; it does not bypass logins, DRM, watermarks or access controls. (3) Downloaded media belongs to its original creators — credit them and respect copyright law. (4) AI-generated captions, hashtags, transcripts, summaries and translations are machine output: review before publishing. (5) The service is provided 'as is' without warranties; abusive use may be rate-limited or blocked.
